name: Cabozantinib (single-agent oral multikinase inhibitor)
cyclesNote: Continuous once-daily oral dosing (represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day continuous-dosing accounting cycle; no drug-free interval). Second- or later-line option after one or two prior systemic agents, Child-Pugh A. Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Take on an empty stomach (no food 2 hours before and 1 hour after).
Hand-foot skin reaction, diarrhea, hypertension: monitor and dose-modify per labeling.
monitoring: blood pressure at baseline and during therapy
symptom review for diarrhea and mucositis

doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and dose-reduce stepwise (e.g. to 40 mg then 20 mg once daily) per labeling; clinical review.

drugs.name: Cabozantinib
drugs.notes: Cabozantinib 60 mg PO once daily on an empty stomach, taken continuously. Second- or later-line oral multikinase inhibitor for advanced HCC after prior systemic therapy, Child-Pugh A. Authored from standard practice (NCCN Hepatocellular Carcinoma; CELESTIAL supporting evidence).
